name: pr-workflow
description: Four skills for the pull request loop: ship one PR end to end, babysit an open PR, review other people's PRs draft-first, and audit web UI.

interface.shortDescription: Ship, babysit and review PRs; audit web UI
interface.longDescription: Four skills for the pull request loop. sonicboom ships one PR end to end from a ticket. babysit keeps an open PR green, merged with its base and answered. pr-pal reviews other people's PRs and shows draft findings before posting. kirei audits a web app's UI at phone and desktop widths and ships the fixes with before and after evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use $pr-pal to review this PR and show me draft comments.
Use $babysit to keep this PR green until it merges.
Use $kirei to audit this page at phone width.
